Package com.salesforce.multicloudj.common.ali

Class AliRetryClassifier

java.lang.Object
com.salesforce.multicloudj.common.ali.AliRetryClassifier
public final class AliRetryClassifier extends Object
Retryability helpers for Alibaba Cloud SDK exceptions.

Unlike GCP (BaseServiceException) or AWS (AwsServiceException), Alibaba's various per-service SDKs (OSS v2, Tablestore, HBR/Tea, aliyuncs-core) do NOT share a common exception base class — every SDK has its own exception types with different shapes. There is no generic classify(Throwable) method that can dispatch over them.

Instead, each provider's mapException extracts the typed exception it cares about and calls one of the helpers below directly. This keeps each service module's classpath tight (no cross-pollination of OSS v2 / Tablestore / Tea jars) and keeps this common module free of any service-specific knowledge.

  • Method Details

    • classifyByStatusCode

      public static Boolean classifyByStatusCode(int httpStatus)
      Classifies an HTTP status code as retryable.
      Parameters:
      httpStatus - HTTP status code from a service exception
      Returns:
      true for 5xx and the retryable 4xx codes (408 Request Timeout, 429 Too Many Requests); false for other 4xx; null otherwise

    • classifyByStatusCode

      public static Boolean classifyByStatusCode(Integer httpStatus)
      Convenience overload accepting a nullable Integer. Returns null when httpStatus is null (e.g., TeaException.getStatusCode() returning a missing status).
